items.source:
fn request_asks_for_a_stream(record: &Json) -> bool {
    record
        .get("body")
        .and_then(|body| body.get("json"))
        .and_then(|body| body.get("stream"))
        .and_then(Json::as_bool)
        .unwrap_or(false)
}
